business_summary: Shandong Iron and Steel Company Ltd. provides iron and steel products in China and internationally. The company offers thick plates, steel profile, special steel, reinforcing steel, hot-rolled coils, cold-rolled coils, and steel bars, etc. Its products are used in automotive, petroleum, railways, bridges, construction, electricity, transportation, machinery, shipbuilding, light industry, and household appliances. The company was formerly known as Jinan Iron & Steel Co. Ltd. Shandong Iron and Steel Company Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Jinan, China. Shandong Iron and Steel Company Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Iron & Steel Group Co.,Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Shandong Iron and Steel Company Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 철강 제품을 제공합니다. 후판, 프로파일, 특수강, 철근, 열연코일, 냉연코일, 철근 등을 생산하는 회사입니다. 해당 제품은 자동차, 석유, 철도, 교량, 건설, 전기, 운송, 기계, 조선, 경공업, 가전제품 등에 사용됩니다. 이 회사의 이전 명칭은 Jinan Iron & Steel Co. Ltd.입니다. Shandong Iron and Steel Company Ltd.는 2000년에 설립되었으며 중국 지난에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Shandong Iron and Steel Company Ltd.는 Shandong Iron & Steel Group Co.,Ltd.의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
